tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background everywhere, and the ground the lyrics sit on. Warm off-white by day, near-black by evening — never pure white or pure black.

tokens.name: paper-raised
tokens.usage: Search field, bottom sheets and menus that float above the page.

tokens.name: paper-sunken
tokens.usage: Quiet wells: the reader toolbar, grouped settings, the index letter rail.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines only: dividers between list rows and between a hymn's header and its first stanza. Never the only thing that shows a control's edge.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (search field, secondary button, chips) — at least 3:1 on `paper`, `paper-raised` and `paper-sunken` in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Lyrics, hymn titles and all primary text, on `paper`, `paper-raised`, `paper-sunken` and `rubric-soft` (≥12:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text — first lines in the index, authors, composers, tune names, captions — on `paper`, `paper-raised`, `paper-sunken` and `rubric-soft` (≥5.9:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: rubric
tokens.usage: The one accent, after the red rubrics of printed hymnals: verse numbers, the hymn number, the “Refrain” label, the active state and the single primary action of a screen. Legible as text on `paper`, `paper-raised`, `paper-sunken` and `rubric-soft` (≥5.7:1 in both themes). Never for whole lines of lyrics.

tokens.name: rubric-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind a selected chip, the active text-size step, and the stanza being followed. `ink`, `ink-muted` and `rubric` all read on it.

tokens.name: on-rubric
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `rubric` fill (primary button). Dark in the Evening theme because the rubric lightens there.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, offset 2px from the control. ≥5.9:1 on every surface in both themes.

groups.name: Hymn
groups.note: Everything that belongs to the hymn itself is set in Literata, a serif drawn for long reading on screens. Sizes here are the default reader size (`reader-size-md`); the reader scales them together.

styles.name: hymn-number
styles.usage: The hymn number at the top of a hymn, in `rubric`, tabular figures.

styles.name: hymn-title
styles.usage: The hymn's title, once, under its number. In `ink`.

styles.name: lyric
styles.sample: Through many dangers, toils and snares, I have already come;
styles.usage: Every line of a stanza. Line height 1.6 so the eye never loses its line while singing.

styles.name: refrain
styles.sample: This is my story, this is my song,
styles.usage: Lines of the refrain or chorus: italic and indented, so it is told apart without colour.

styles.name: verse-number
styles.usage: The number hung in the margin beside a stanza's first line, in `rubric`. Its line height matches `lyric` so it sits on the first baseline.

styles.name: attribution
styles.sample: Words: John Newton, 1779 · Tune: NEW BRITAIN
styles.usage: Author, translator, composer, tune and date, under the title and in the credits at the end. In `ink-muted`.

groups.name: Interface
groups.note: Everything that is the app rather than the hymn: navigation, lists, controls, settings.

styles.name: screen-title
styles.usage: One per screen, top left: Index, Favorites, Settings.

styles.name: list-title
styles.usage: A hymn's title in a list row.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Search by number, title or first line.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, chips, field labels, toolbar items.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Holy, holy, holy! Lord God Almighty!
styles.usage: First line under a list title, small metadata. In `ink-muted`.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: The only uppercase in the system: section labels in lists (Advent, Easter) and the “Refrain” label above a refrain. In `rubric` or `ink-muted`.

spacing.note: A 4px base, used generously: when in doubt, take the next step up.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to its label; number to its title inside a list row.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips; inside compact controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of list rows and buttons.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Horizontal page gutter on phones; padding inside fields and cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Refrain indent; page gutter on tablets; gap between the hymn header and the first stanza.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Space between stanzas — one full `lyric` line, so stanzas breathe without drifting apart.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Above the credits at the end of a hymn; top of a hymn below the toolbar.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Bottom of a hymn, so the last line never sits on the screen edge or under a toolbar.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, the text-size steps, small wells.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, the search field, sheets' inner cards.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Round icon buttons (44×44) only.

shadow.note: Depth is rare: the page is flat paper. Only things that float over the hymn get a shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets, menus and the floating reader toolbar.

layout.note: Reading comfort. The reader offers four text sizes; the measure keeps lyric lines from stretching on wide screens.

tokens.name: measure-lyrics
tokens.usage: Max width of the lyrics column; centred on tablets and desktop, left-aligned inside it.

tokens.name: measure-prose
tokens.usage: Max width of notes, history and settings text.

tokens.name: tap-target
tokens.usage: Minimum height and width of anything tappable.

tokens.name: reader-size-sm
tokens.usage: Small reader step: `lyric` size; other hymn styles scale in proportion.

tokens.name: reader-size-md
tokens.usage: Default reader step — the `lyric` size in the type scale.

tokens.name: reader-size-lg
tokens.usage: Large reader step.

tokens.name: reader-size-xl
tokens.usage: Extra-large step, for low vision or a phone held at arm's length while standing.
